import os

print("cwd:", os.getcwd())
print("\nfull listing of cwd (including hidden):")
for entry in sorted(os.listdir(".")):
    print(" ", entry, "(dir)" if os.path.isdir(entry) else "(file)")

print("\nany 'docs' dir anywhere?")
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("/", topdown=True):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in {"proc", "sys", "dev", "run", "usr", "lib", "lib64", "bin", "sbin", "etc", "var", "opt", "boot", "snap"}]
    if os.path.basename(root) == "explanation" and "docs" in root:
        print(" ", root, "->", files[:20])
